content:
maya: FYI — seeing repeated KV cache eviction spike alerts during nightly backups. They fire ~3-4x each night and are noisy. Can we tune or add a mute window?
ops-bot: [ALERT] KV_CACHE_EVICT_SPIKE service:redwood-runtime env:prod count:7 last:2026-02-20T00:12:03Z link: https://datadog.com/monitors/12345
liam: I noticed this as well. Mostly coincides with backup jobs and rolling restarts. Current monitor threshold is 5% eviction_rate over 1m. We could bump to 12% or add a scheduled downtime.
jun: +1 for a short mute window 00:00-02:30 UTC. Backups run ~00:15-00:45 and sometimes overlap with node restarts. Also recommend scoping monitor by shard/host so one bad host doesn't trigger global noise.
sre-oncall: Can you paste the dashboard and the exact query so I can review impact? We should avoid hiding real regressions. Also who needs the mute permission? Ops or SRE?
maya: Dashboard: https://grafana.redwoodinfra.com/d/kv-cache/kvcache-overview?orgId=1
Log query (example): prod.kv.cache | measure eviction_rate | avg(1m) by host
Observed: host-gpu-12 18%, host-gpu-3 16% during backup window. Outside window typical <3%.
liam: Proposed monitor update: scope by host (or shard), condition: avg(eviction_rate) by host > 12% for 2 minutes. Recovery: avg < 8% for 3 minutes. Add mute schedule 00:00-02:30 UTC on weekdays. Also add a high-severity exemption: if eviction_rate > 40% for any host, still page immediately.
jun: I'll open a PR to change the Datadog monitor and add the schedule. Can we also silence the flurry of historical alerts for the last 24h? :eyes:
sre-oncall: OK — temporary mute approved for 48 hours from now while PR goes through, but keep the 40% hard-exemption that still pages. Please include the before/after graphs in the PR description so we can revert if needed.
maya: Thanks. I'll annotate incidents and notify backup team. I'll also attach examples of the noisy alerts to the PR.
liam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/789 — changes include monitor scope, threshold bump, recovery window, and schedule.
sre-oncall: Approved for 48h temporary mute. Create a follow-up ticket to review this after two backup cycles and consider tuning backup parallelism instead of permanently raising thresholds. :thumbsup:
maya: Great — will do. Thanks everyone :pray:
ops-bot: [INFO] mute schedule applied to monitor 12345 until 2026-02-22T12:30:00Z
jun: I'll watch metrics first thing tomorrow and post numbers in this thread.
sre-oncall: Closing thread for now; keep updates here if anything unexpected happens.
